newsitem.title: USA: Complete Management files for offering.
newsitem.headline: Complete Management files for offering.

text.p: Complete Management Inc said on Tuesday it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities Exchange Commission for a stock and debt offering.
The company said it would offer to sell 2.5 million shares and $25 million of convertible subordinated debentures, and a non-management shareholder would offer to sell 500,000 shares.
Proceeds would be mostly used to fund future acquisitions and also for general corporate purposes, the company said.
The new debt would be listed on the American Stock Exchange, the company said.
National Securities Corp was the lead underwriter and the deal would be co-managed by Commonwealth Associates, Complete Management said.
